verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an immigration law firm, but the evidence pack shows no advertised approval or success rate and no stated basis such as case counts, time window or methodology. The only quantitative claim is '60 years of experience,' which is not a success rate and carries no methodology.

support.subject: As a founder, any advertised approval or success rate comes with a stated basis — case counts, time window, or methodology — on the provider's own pages
